WITH circuit_averages AS (
  SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
scored AS (
  SELECT circuitId, country, avg_round,
         avg_round - AVG(avg_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS difference
  FROM circuit_averages
)
SELECT circuitId, country, avg_round, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
